body:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager: auth-proxy alert A-42702 firing — surge in 401s and suspicious token reuse across regions (us-east-1, eu-central-1). Paging @sre_oncall.

sre_oncall: Investigating. Initial signals show repeated token fragments appearing in staging log dumps and a concentrated set of IPs hitting /v1/token endpoints. Opening incident.

anne: Any customer-facing errors or escalations? Who owns staging logshipper?

miguel: Quick sanitized log sample:
```
2026-03-16T02:05:11Z auth-proxy svc=token-proxy req=... ip=3.121.45.67 status=401 token_frag=eyJhbGci... bucket=/staging/logs/2026-03-16/part-0001.gz
2026-03-16T02:05:12Z auth-proxy svc=token-proxy req=... ip=3.121.45.67 status=401 token_frag=eyJhbGci... svc_account=dedicated-77
```
Found ~27 token-ish fragments; 2 map to active dedicated svc accounts.

anne: Ok we need immediate containment. @kai start rotating svc-account credentials and add a temporary WAF block for the offending IP range. Also pause the staging logshipper job.

kai: Kicking off rotate playbook (run: rotate-20260316-01). Pausing logshipper-connector staging ingestion now. ETA ~5m.

infra-bot: rotate submitted: https://infra/jobs/rotate-20260316-01 status=in_progress

miguel: Copying suspect objects to quarantine-bucket/forensics/2026-03-16 then running token-grep. Dry-run first.

legal: Preserve all object keys + hashes before deletion. Start PII scan on quarantined objects. Notify privacy if any PII.

sre_oncall: Action list: 1) rotate tokens (kai) 2) WAF block and pause logshipper (anne/kai) 3) quarantine + preserve forensics (miguel/legal) 4) PII scan and customer impact assessment (legal/CSM). Keep updates here.

kai: rotate-20260316-01: rotated 2 svc accounts (dedicated-77, dedicated-88), revoked old tokens, propagated to Dedicated pools at 2026-03-16T02:11:09Z.

anne: WAF rule applied blocking 3.121.45.0/24 and tightened rate limits on /v1/token. Rule id waf-temp-20260316-3. Monitoring for false positives.

miguel: Quarantine dry-run found 9 objects. Copied to quarantine-bucket/forensics/2026-03-16. Running PII grep; will not delete originals until legal signs off.

legal: PII scan: no obvious customer PII detected. Risk level low. Preparing internal CSM note listing the two affected Dedicated customers. Will not escalate externally at this time.

sre_oncall: Spike returned to baseline after rotations and WAF. Keeping alert level elevated for 45 minutes. Next: RCA on how token fragments ended up in staging logs and add logging-scrub guardrails.

anne: Filed RFC 2026-03: logging-scrub: reject token-like patterns from logshipper and add CI check to block deployments that change log format. Assigned to infra devex.

legal: Drafted internal customer advisory for CSMs. No external notice required per policy. Will update if forensics show broader exposure.

pagerbot: Incident A-42702 mitigations applied: tokens rotated, WAF block active, staging objects quarantined. Monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:

sre_oncall: Will close thread in 45m if stable. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-17 10:00 PT. Add any residual notes to the incident doc. Thanks all.
